check_events.outcome: Let p:E→G be an extension with kernel N. Strict homomorphic sections s,t:G→E define functors between the one-object groupoids BG and BE over BG. A natural isomorphism between them has a component a∈E satisfying t(g)a=a s(g), or t(g)=a s(g)a^{-1}. Being a natural isomorphism over BG requires p(a)=1, precisely a∈N. Conversely any such a∈N gives the natural isomorphism. Thus isomorphism classes of these strict groupoid sections are N-conjugacy classes. This proves only the elementary groupoid interpretation; it does not prove the page's geometric injectivity or cusp-scindage assertions and does not decide the visible B/E overwrites.
